messages:
clare: Heads up  I found a mismatch between the API reference and the generated SDK snippets for POST /v1/generate. The Go example uses `MaxTokens` and reads `Choices[0].Text`, but the runtime and OpenAPI use `max_new_tokens` and return `output: [{text:...}]`. Customers hit this in the quickstart.

ben: Oof. Which files are out of sync?

clare: The markdown page is content/api/generate.md; snippets come from site/_snippets/generate_examples.yaml and the Go snippet generator uses templates in tools/snippet-gen/go.tmpl. The OpenAPI spec (openapi/generate.yaml) already has `max_new_tokens` and an `output` array.

ishaan: Can you paste the minimal repro curl + response you used? I'll add it to the patch.

clare: Repro (staging):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/fast-1","max_new_tokens":24,"prompt":"Explain ACID in one paragraph"}'
```
Response:
```
{"id":"gen_2468","model":"redwood/fast-1","output":[{"text":"ACID stands for...","type":"text"}]}
```

ben: Thanks. Plan of attack: (1) canonicalize docs to `max_new_tokens` and the `output` array shape in content/api/generate.md, (2) update snippet source site/_snippets/generate_examples.yaml, (3) patch tools/snippet-gen/go.tmpl so the Go quickstart shows reading `resp.Output[0].Text`, (4) add a short migration note mapping `max_tokens` -> `max_new_tokens`, and (5) add a tiny example-validation test that compares example responses to openapi/generate.yaml.

ishaan: I'll add the migration note and a one-paragraph blurb for the migration guide. Suggest wording: "Rename `max_tokens` to `max_new_tokens` for Generate endpoints. Server will accept `max_tokens` for one release, but update clients to avoid confusion."

clare: Also found a link in the Go quickstart pointing to the old JS example path /docs/examples/js/generate.md  that should point to the new canonical examples. I'll fix that link in the markdown.

snippet-bot: snippet-gen: regeneration required for generate_examples.yaml. Queued job #4321.

docs-bot: docs-ci: example-validation failed for content/api/generate.md (schema mismatch). See https://ci.internal.redwood/4321 :x:

ben: Does the Go SDK actually accept `MaxTokens` at runtime? We should verify server still maps the old name for compatibility before we flip docs.

ishaan: Quick check against staging shows server accepts both keys: `max_tokens` and `max_new_tokens` are mapped server-side. I'll add an integration example in the tests that POSTs both keys to show mapping.

clare: I opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1212 with the docs change, snippet update, and the example test. Please review.

ben: Reviewing now. Once merged, I'll run snippet-gen locally and push regenerated Go snippets. Then we should post a short note in #support and update the release changelog.

ishaan: Added the migration note to docs/migration.md and included the integration test in tests/examples/test_generate_examples.py.

clare: Thanks all. After merge, let's watch support tickets for any lingering confusion and close the loop with a tiny FAQ entry in the Generate doc.

ben: Agreed. Ping me when the Go snippets are regenerated and I'll validate the quickstart build. :thumbsup:
